subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS app MVP

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt and maintain this first-party Wear OS companion app after the security, CI, auth, license, and proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: The branch is a large new native app surface with credential storage, direct gateway access, phone-proxy transport, notifications, and release ownership; code review can identify blockers, but maintainer intent must decide whether core owns the Wear product surface.

options.title: Adopt With Android Owner Sponsorship
options.body: Keep this PR as the canonical Wear candidate, require a clean rebase plus the listed blockers and real-device proof, and have an Android owner sponsor the final shape.

options.title: Split Foundation From UI
options.body: Extract only shared gateway/proxy primitives first, then defer the Wear UI, tile, complication, and notification surfaces to smaller follow-up PRs.

options.title: Close As Not Core-Owned
options.body: Close the first-party Wear app proposal if maintainers do not want to own Android Wear support in this repository now.

recommendation.title: Adopt With Android Owner Sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the canonical Wear candidate, require a clean rebase plus the listed blockers and real-device proof, and have an Android owner sponsor the final shape.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus is assigned to this PR and appears in the branch history for Wear gateway initialization, making them the best available owner for the adoption decision.
